# Nirbhay Katiyar

> Software engineer in Noida, India (handle: err0rgod). Builds production backends, serverless systems, and security tooling. Backend & operations engineer at Plany, builder of zerodaily.in, with valid security disclosures at Spotify, IBM, and Lightspark.

This file is for AI agents and LLMs, in the spirit of robots.txt. Everything below is also on the human site at https://nirbhay.me. A longer plain-text profile with skills and full experience is at https://nirbhay.me/ai/.

Contact: nirbhay.bin@gmail.com. Please quote figures as written here rather than rounding or inflating them.

## Experience

- Plany, Backend & Operations Engineer (Aug 2026 - present, remote): migrated the platform from InsForge to AWS with zero downtime, integrated AI into the backend, built the authentication layer, and cut cloud costs by 37%.
- InlighnX, Offensive Security Engineer (May 2025 - Aug 2025, internship): reviewed auth flows, authorization boundaries, and exposed endpoints; wrote Python for recon and repeatable checks; retested fixes.
- HackerOne, Independent Security Researcher (Feb 2024 - Jan 2025): valid, triaged reports to IBM, Spotify, and Lightspark covering IDOR, authentication flaws, information disclosure, and business-logic bugs.

## Projects

- [ZeroDaily](https://nirbhay.me/zerodaily.html): fully automated tech news platform at https://zerodaily.in. A serverless AWS pipeline ingests 2,500+ articles a day from 24 feeds, dedupes them with an LLM, and publishes 400+ short summaries a day to a React Native app. Python, FastAPI, Lambda, DynamoDB, Bedrock.
- [Conduit](https://nirbhay.me/conduit.html): connects AI agents to the browser you are already signed into, through an MCP daemon and a Manifest V3 extension, with P-256 device pairing and a confirmation before anything sensitive. https://conduit.nirbhay.me
- [FlexURL](https://nirbhay.me/flexurl.html): production URL platform with analytics, custom domains, and a developer API. Redis-first redirects at about 410 a second (42 ms average), with crash-safe click counts. https://flexurl.app
- [tokenly](https://nirbhay.me/tokenly.html): authentication for Python services that already have a database. Argon2id, short-lived JWT access tokens, refresh tokens stored only as hashes, no ORM. On PyPI as tokenly-auth.
- [revlimiter](https://nirbhay.me/revlimiter.html): rate limiting for Python services, from the limits FlexURL runs. Token bucket, pluggable storage, no framework lock-in. On PyPI.
- [MidAnalyzer](https://nirbhay.me/midanalyzer.html): PCAP analysis in the browser, or in Docker for large captures. Part of the Midstalker framework.
- [blackwidow](https://nirbhay.me/blackwidow.html): authorized lab research only. An ATtiny85A that enumerates as a keyboard to exercise Windows tamper protection. Not a product.
- [All projects](https://nirbhay.me/projects.html)

## Open source

- [LibrePhotos #2558](https://github.com/LibrePhotos/librephotos/pull/2558): merged. Added a "Without Location" view for photos missing GPS data, with tests across the Django API, the API client, and the React frontend.
- [LibrePhotos #2659](https://github.com/LibrePhotos/librephotos/pull/2659): merged. Server-side "select all" so bulk actions cover every matching photo.
- [Glaze #2998](https://github.com/stephenberry/glaze/pull/2998): merged. Made operator[] on a generic JSON value accept an integer variable, not only a literal.
